variants.why_present: Well-known BRCA2 founder frameshift (historically 6174delT, p.Ser1982ArgfsTer22). Multiple strong computational criteria fire. The evidence trail is the product, not the label.
variants.expected_behavior: PVS1 and PM2 apply. Classification is Likely pathogenic under the 2015 table (1 very strong + 1 moderate). No conflict. High confidence.

features.gold_source: ENIGMA PVS1 + PM2_supporting; 2015 table does not have 1 VS + 1 supporting = LP
features.notes: Walkthrough step 2. Under default 2015 PM2-as-moderate this becomes LP; under ClinGen SVI PM2-as-supporting it stays VUS. That disagreement is the point.

variants.why_present: Common BRCA2 p.Asn372His polymorphism. gnomAD AF is well above 5%, so BA1 fires alone and terminates the chain.
variants.expected_behavior: BA1 applies. Remaining criteria are listed as skipped. No literature-node LLM calls. Classification Benign.

features.gold_source: Richards 2015 BA1; ENIGMA BA1 also met
features.notes: Walkthrough step 3. AF 0.27 is a designed stand-in for the published N372H frequency, not a live gnomAD pull.

variants.why_present: A genuine VUS shape: absent from gnomAD (PM2) and benign in-silico (BP4). A naive classifier that sums scores will pick a side.
variants.expected_behavior: Output flags CONFLICTING EVIDENCE, lists both directions, does not emit a single ACMG tier.

features.notes: Walkthrough step 4. HGVS is a designed probe, not a claim about this exact ClinVar record.

variants.why_present: Missense in a gene whose VCEP requires absence from gnomAD for PM2. This allele is present at AF 8e-6, so default 2015 PM2 (AF<1e-5) fires and the VCEP does not.
variants.expected_behavior: Report both the default call and the gene-specific override. Do not silently pick one threshold.

features.clingen_vcep: ClinGen absent-only PM2 overlay (ENIGMA-style) on MYH7
features.gold_source: VCEP PM2 requires absence; AF 8e-6 is present
features.notes: Designed AF, not a live gnomAD lookup. Demonstrates the override path named in the spec.

variants.why_present: Olfactory-receptor gene with no ClinGen VCEP and no ClinVar expert-panel record in the committed catalog snapshot. The system must refuse rather than guess.
variants.expected_behavior: Return insufficient evidence. Do not emit an ACMG tier. Non-zero confidence is a bug.

features.gold_source: No ClinVar / ClinGen coverage in the sample catalog
features.notes: Walkthrough step 5. Catalog coverage is a committed empty snapshot, not a live ClinVar query.
